depth_evidence.meaning: Historical native diagnostic: wading begins at200 and swimming at2000 drams in that tested state. Runtime predicates remain authoritative; do not reproduce threshold rules from this art file.

liquid_identity: Pond declares water-600,salt-400 and500 drams. Deep pool declares4000,extra deep8000. Captured shallow Joppa pools do not prove a naturally occurring swimming-depth cell. Deep is a required authored supported state, not a new spawned pool.

native_capture.limit: Historical original Joppa pool patch, not a new capture or deep-water observation. Dynamic connected liquid display differs from the small default puddle sprite.

donor_reference.name: WaterDeepRamp
donor_reference.role: Actual WaterDeepRamp supplies restrained smooth tonal variation and connected-material presentation only. Its muted donor gray/blue, UV interpretation and water-depth simulation are not transplanted by this art conversion.

source_palette.interpretation: Native Water default foreground is b and the captured pool uses b/B. Separate b/B color roles preserve the source blue family; deeper subdued reflectance is authored, not a native physics statement.

construction: Neutral smooth open-water plane with sparse flowing curved ripples, no repeated per-cell rim, pebbles, caustic bottom, foam border or opaque donor color. Deep texture should read darker/calmer than the later shallow state.
states: One world-continuous material, wet/dry shore coverage and independent deep/shallow blend coverage using native state ownership. Reuse compatible eight-neighbor geometry with water/depth semantics, not path rules.
frame: Flat top-down surface, no creature turnarounds, anatomy or equipment. Material is world-anchored, never independently cropped per water cell.
bindings: Actual open-volume visibility and water proportion select eligibility; other liquids, concealed/unsupported states retain native graphics. Depth uses IsSwimmingDepth/IsWadingDepth; no volume mutation or generic liquid-color inference.

adapter_evidence.note: Existing adapter has world-continuous water UV and native depth capture, but uses fixed tints/material selection and a four-cardinal perimeter. New neutral color roles, diagonal coverage and separate depth blending remain final integration work.
